name: pruebatecnica
description: Prueba Tecnica desarrollada en Node.js, Express y PostgreSQL

scripts.db:test:create: cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_NAME=vending_test_db sequelize-cli db:create --env test
scripts.db:test:migrate: cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_NAME=vending_test_db sequelize-cli db:migrate --env test
scripts.db:test:seed: cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_NAME=vending_test_db sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env test
scripts.db:test:reset: cross-env NODE_ENV=test DB_NAME=vending_test_db sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --env test && npm run db:test:migrate && npm run db:test:seed
